_comment: Cockpit team roster (generic seed for the AI-OS Starter Kit). Fully data-driven: the cockpit UI and status probes read this file, so adding or renaming an agent needs no code change. Fields: key = Hermes profile name; soul = the persona file under agents/ this profile uses; name = display name (defaults to the role; set your own in the naming step, see docs/GOING_LIVE.md); role/desc = shown in the UI; port = gateway API port (null = not deployed yet, status 'planned'); accent = UI accent colour token. No proper names, no personal data. Rename agents with scripts/name_agents.py or by editing the 'name' fields here.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.desc: Takes requests, routes to the team, bundles results back.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.desc: Market and competitor research, comparisons, fact-checks.

agents.name: Developer
agents.desc: Builds tools and features on branches, opens PRs, never deploys.

agents.name: Maintenance
agents.desc: Infra, monitoring, updates, backups, reviews and deploys.

agents.name: Writer
agents.desc: Drafts posts, articles and emails in the user's voice.
